description: This PHP source file defines an abstract class `NativeResource` within the AWS\CRT namespace. The class manages native resources, tracking outstanding resources and facilitating leak checks by maintaining static properties for resources and CRT instance. It includes methods for resource acquisition, release, and cleanup in destructor.

classes.name: NativeResource
classes.description: An abstract base class for native resources that tracks resource management and leak detection.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the CRT instance if not already set and registers the resource object.

methods.name: acquire
methods.description: Assigns a handle to the native resource.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Releases the native resource handle and returns it.

methods.name: __destruct
methods.description: Ensures the resource has been released before destruction and removes the object from the resource tracking list.
